metadata.title: Secure Data Relying System SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan template for systems that produce, consume, store, or process institutional data under the Trusted Data architecture.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: An application or service that relies on the Secure Data Platform for data classification, protection, lifecycle governance, and loss prevention without implementing data trust controls independently.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system relies on the Secure Data Platform SSPP for authoritative data trust, protection, and lifecycle enforcement.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: The system consumes Secure Identity for access enforcement and attribution related to data use.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: The system relies on Secure Network for protected data transport, segmentation, and monitoring.

props.name: data-consumption-model
props.remarks: The system consumes data trust, classification, and protection requirements defined by Secure Data and does not define its own data protection semantics.

props.name: data-governance-boundary
props.remarks: Classification, encryption, loss prevention, and retention are enforced by the Secure Data Platform, not by the relying system.

props.name: application-responsibility
props.remarks: The relying system defines business context and function but must operate within Secure Data constraints.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Relying systems participate in data workflows while preserving defined trust and responsibility boundaries.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.value: PL, AC, IA, AU, SC, MP
props.remarks: Data-related security and privacy controls are inherited from the Secure Data Platform SSPP.

props.name: crypto-restriction
props.remarks: The relying system must not generate, store, or manage cryptographic keys outside the Key Management Platform.

props.name: certificate-restriction
props.remarks: The relying system must not issue, store, or trust self-signed or locally managed certificates. All certificates must be issued and validated by the PKI Platform.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP documents reliance on Secure Data services and explicitly prohibits local reimplementation of data trust controls.

components.title: Data-Reliant Application Component
components.description: Logical representation of an application that produces, accesses, processes, or stores institutional data.

roles.title: System Owner
roles.remarks: Defines business context, acceptable data use, and integration points with Secure Data.

roles.title: Data Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Ensures correct inheritance, use, and enforcement of Secure Data patterns.

control-implementation.remarks: All data classification, protection, loss prevention, and retention controls are inherited from the Secure Data Platform SSPP. This SSPP documents reliance and boundary conditions only. All cryptographic operations, including encryption, signing, and trust validation, are inherited from the Key Management and PKI Platforms. The relying system is prohibited from implementing local cryptographic trust mechanisms.
